body_html:
Meet John Murray: the mastermind behind the beats and announcements that turn events into legendary experiences! John’s epic journey began at JAMMIN’ DJs, where he rocked the role of General Manager at the Atlanta office. Not one to settle, he turbocharged the company to reach dazzling new heights before embarking on a Rocky Mountain adventure to Colorado. There, he unleashed his visionary prowess, birthing the Colorado office in the year 2000.

Fast forward, and behold the marvel that is JAMMIN’ DJs/Infinity Entertainment: the crowned jewel of entertainment in Colorado & Georgia. With a “show must go on” mantra tattooed on his soul, John’s infectious passion for crafting unforgettable moments catapulted JAMMIN’ DJs/Infinity Entertainment to stardom across multiple states.

From his very first event at age 16, John’s been a tour de force in entertainment, grooving through disc jockey companies, electrifying sports arenas, setting dance floors ablaze in nightclubs, and even serenading the airwaves. Oh, and did we mention he’s the wizard behind the curtain at the Atlanta Braves’ games? That’s right, folks-John’s the In-game and special event DJ for the Braves, adding his signature vibe to America’s favorite pastime.

But wait, there’s more! John’s not just about the beats; he’s got pipes of gold too. He has been the voice echoing through the hallowed halls of the University of Colorado, amping up Men’s Basketball and Football fans. Not to be outdone, he’s also lent his vocal prowess to the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets, rallying spirits in the arenas of Men’s Basketball, Women’s Basketball, Baseball, Volleyball, and Football. His vocal escapades extend across states and borders, from Colorado State University to the global phenomenon that is the Harlem Globetrotters, even hyping up USA Boxing, Olympic Trials, The Churchill Cup, and beyond. Picture it: John’s voice reverberating through arenas around the world, igniting excitement in the hearts of fans across the globe.

With a resume as eclectic as a mixtape, John has rocked over 100 arenas and crossed international boundaries to spread his infectious energy. He’s not just about fun and games though-his knack for diverse entertainment has fueled his business brilliance. He’s expanded his empire by spinning his entertainment magic into premier services, making every event an unforgettable extravaganza.

So whether it’s dropping beats, hyping crowds, or transforming gatherings into unforgettable spectacles, John Murray is the maestro who orchestrates moments that resonate for a lifetime. Get ready to jam with the legend himself!
